items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury; Rams optimistic after feeling better Saturday, no setbacks.
items.why: Calf minor per McVay; source confirmed availability.
items.implication: Start with confidence; high WR ranking upside.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in favorable spot.

items.text: Breece Hall officially inactive (quad); unlikely after limited practice, may return Week 8. Misses fourth straight.
items.why: Hasn't been full participant; early for return.
items.implication: Jets RB committee without him; handcuff/backup elevated for volume.
items.opportunity: Lead back opportunity for remaining Jets RBs vs MIA.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT after being questionable with ankle injury. Crucial for DFS slate; projections updated.
items.why: Weekend reports summary from ETR; ankle issue.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; backup QB elevated, Flowers/Andrews/Henry volume may shift.

items.text: Think Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain. He still produced as lead (124 yds/17/1 TD).
items.implication: Monitor for next week; handcuff if available. Berry hated pre-game for matchup.
items.opportunity: Lead role confirmed this week but sustainability?
items.conflict: Rapoport noted lead expected + strong production; Berry hated spot.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; almost certainly fine. Would be tilting if serious from not scoring.
items.implication: No downgrade; continue as elite RB1.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT. Eagles pass game thinned.
items.implication: AJ Brown/Goedert/others elevated targets; reverse any prior Smith love.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share for remaining PHI pass-catchers.
items.conflict: Berry had loved DeVonta pre-OUT for volume/matchup.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (MNF vs DAL). Efficient in recent full games; strong RB matchup.
items.why: Reports summary; in line to play.
items.implication: Start if active; Dallas good for RBs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN after layoff. Berry hated post-layoff workload questions vs DET.
items.implication: Startable but monitor snap share post-absence.

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; will be Broncos RB you wish you had by year end. Designated return, prior production.
items.why: Preseason take confirmed; touches before injury, current backs inefficient.
items.opportunity: Potential role expansion vs JK Dobbins/Harvey.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, usage/matchup vs Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Usage rebound + Bears defense allows yardage; amplified by Smith/Wicks OUT.

items.text: LOVE Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6): Lions TE buffet, allowed many TE TDs/fantasy points.
items.why: Matchup vs vulnerable Lions TE defense.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9): big workload in friendly matchup vs run-vulnerable defense.
LOVE Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10): consistent volume in solid spot.
HATE Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32): shadow by Gonzalez likely; 90% outside targets, limited production history.
